BUCKET.description: The R2 bucket this CDN serves. Every path on the Worker streams an object out of it, and `POST /api/upload` is the only way in.

CDN_PASSWORD.description: **The only value you need.** Password for the file explorer at `/` — object URLs stay public, this gates the browse/upload/delete UI. Let your password manager generate it: it also signs your session cookie unless you set `CDN_SESSION_SECRET` below.

CDN_UPLOAD_TOKEN.description: **Optional, leave blank.** Bearer token for `POST /api/upload` — how scripts, CLIs and hooks write. Blank means no machine write path at all (every bearer is rejected); you can still upload by dragging onto the explorer. `cdn setup` generates one when you want it.

CDN_SESSION_SECRET.description: **Optional, leave blank.** Signs the explorer's session cookie. Blank derives the key from your password, which is why this deploy only asks for one thing. Set it (`openssl rand -hex 32`) to rotate sessions independently of the password.

CDN_PURGE_TOKEN.description: **Optional, leave blank.** A [Cloudflare API token](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens) scoped to *Zone → Cache Purge*, so an overwritten file goes stale on every edge POP at once. Only useful once you have added a custom domain — `cdn setup` mints it for you.
